scope: History learning when host context starts inside a long technical token
cause: TypingHistory.observe treats last whitespace-split fragment as complete even when it begins at supplied context boundary. Partial suffix is below 64-character admission cap while original exceeds cap.
examples: 76-character email rejected with full context; 32-character context learns seruseruseruseruser@example.com.
101-character URL rejected whole; truncated gment/segment/segment/file.json stored and recalled.
limits: Host context cutoffs of 32/48 deliberately injected; no claim iOS uses those lengths or reproduced on-device.
App extraction modeled from source, production PersonalHistory storage/recall executed.
Synthetic technical strings, no private data.
This does not justify dropping every first token: true document start must be distinguished from unknown context boundary.
